ctx.x: Well, I first met Ben Webster in 1939 when I came to New York. I told, the last time we were here, it was like a starving child walking into the world's greatest

bakery. They had Lunceford was in the Paramount Theater, Basie was on 52nd Street, Art Tatum was on 52nd Street, Duke Ellington was at the Apollo, Louis Armstrong was at the Cotton Club, Roy Eldridge was at the Kelly's Stables, and then who followed Roy Eldridge in but Coleman Hawkins, the only sax player I ever really loved. If I had been Louis Armstrong, I would have wanted Coleman Hawkins. And I was there every night after we closed at the Waldorf; I was with Benny. And I would be right there at the bar, I…
